assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production smartphone portrait chapter background for an illustrated portfolio. Create ONE new true portrait painting, approximately 1024x2048 (1:2 tall aspect ratio). Reference image 1 is the existing landscape Home painting: preserve its exact charcoal-black, silver-gray and restrained pale-gold palette, hand-painted dense watercolor/ink paper relief texture, architecture, and atmosphere, but REDRAW and RECOMPOSE the entire scene for a tall canvas. This is NOT a center crop, resize, stretched landscape, or landscape embedded inside a tall border. Preserve ALL recognizable features: monumental closed twin archive doors with a luminous circular central seal and narrow vertical seam, broad stepped foundation, reflective water, distant jagged mountains and waterfalls, small cloaked standing man on the left cliff, delicate leaf branches at the outer edges, star flecks, giant golden planetary ring arc at upper right. Portrait arrangement: gate complete and undistorted at x=50%, from y=46% to 78%; full cloaked figure visibly inside the frame at x=18%, head near y=44%, overlooking gate from a left cliff; reflections and water in bottom 20%; ring arc bends inside upper-right 20%. Keep the upper-middle left (x=10%-70%, y=21%-40%) quiet dark ink sky with sparse clouds for overlaid title text, and top 18% relatively calm for controls. The foreground and skyline must feel native to this tall composition; do not omit the man, waterfalls, trees, seal, steps or ring to fit. Entire painting full bleed. No text, letters, logos, UI, panels, labels, borders or watermark.
